_comment: Cross-dataset identity fixes for the site-level merge. slugAliases: variant -> canonical (slugs computed with the unified slugifier: diacritics stripped, apostrophes dropped). preferredNames: canonical slug -> display name override.
_notes: cindy-yushi-tsai: IJSO 2007 sources (OBC/wiki/OLC majority) spell Yushi; the IOAA 2008 dataset has Yuchi (single Objetivo-style variant). Provisional canonical = Yushi; revisit if a primary document surfaces.
imo d-emidio divergence is handled automatically: the merge re-slugs everyone from the display name with the unified rule, so per-folder id spelling differences cannot split people.
thiago-bergamaschi: IJSO 2014 'Thiago R. Bergamaschi' = IPhO 2016 'Thiago Bergamaschi' (user-confirmed 2026-08-22). NOT his brother Thomas Ross-White Bergamaschi (distinct.json).
pedro-seber-e-silva: IChO 2016 'Pedro Silva' = 'Pedro Seber e Silva' per ABQ-SP records the fuller form — links his IChO silver to IOAA 2016 bronze.
luis-fernando-machado-poletti-valle: OLC records the fuller 'Machado' form; OIbF 2013 + IOAA 2013 same person.
guilherme-issao-camarinha-fujiwara: IOI 2003 'C.' = Camarinha (IMO 2002).
gabriel-tavares-bujokas: IOI 2006 short form; ultra-rare surname, adjacent years to IMO 2004/05.
nicholas-de-souza-costa-lima: IChO 2013 ABQ short form vs IJSO 2011 OBC full form; junior-to-senior progression.

italo-rennan-lima-silva: IPhO 2016 'Italo Silva' (ipho-unofficial abbreviation) = IJSO 2014 silver medalist from Fortaleza-CE; classic junior-to-senior progression, rare given name (user-confirmed as most likely, 2026-08-22).

eleni-claire-shor: competed IPhO 2019 under a former name (user-confirmed 2026-08-22); alias future-proofs against splits if older records surface. hideVariants keeps the former name out of the public UI — display is always the current name.

OII merge batch 2026-08-22: ten IOI-DB short forms folded into OII/OBI full forms — every pair pre-documented in the ioi collection's name-variants cross-check (plus Cesario 2002 IOI = 2004 CIIC, rare name + era). Frederico: IOI 'Souza' vs OII/OBI 'Sousa' — Sousa canonical.

carolina-moura: IOI-DB short form (2020-22) = Carolina Moura Valle Costa (OII/EGOI; pre-documented in ioi variants table). Missed by the detector's last-token blocking — bug fixed same day (block on all tokens).

leonardo-henrique-martins-florentino: OIbF 2015 dataset lacked the surname Florentino — NOIC's contemporary roster spells 'LEONARDO H. M. FLORENTINO' (flag opened in the oibf source pass, closed by the widened detector 2026-08-22). IJSO 2013 silver = same person.

2026-08-25: imported all 16 slug aliases from small-world's scripts/lib/aliases.ts as defensive no-ops — their merges are already baked into our canonical physics raw files, but the variant spellings survive in the provenance scrape files (ipho-unofficial.json, supplementary.json, eupho-pdfs.json); these aliases guard any future rebuild-from-scrape or source reusing the short/typo forms.
ian-barreto-tavares-matos-de-vasconcelos: IChO official DB abbreviates 'M' = Matos (IMChO 2025 official xlsx has the full form). Same student, IChO 2025 bronze + IMChO 2025 bronze.

OIAQ merge batch 2026-08-26: eleven IChO short/variant forms folded into OIAQ full forms (same-year chemistry pairs: Arthur Braga Reis, Celso Renan, Davi Aragão, Caminha, Lígia, Pedro Madeira Nóbrega, Maurocélio+Filho, Teotônio Sousa/Souza, Yuri Morales/Moraes, Castelo Branco, Mathews/Matheus, Ivna F.=Ferreira). Souza/Moraes/Matheus display forms chosen where sources conflict.

APMO/EGMO batch 2026-09-08: IMO-DB short forms 'Enzo Holanda' (IMO 2026 BRA3 per OBM's team announcement: Enzo Holanda Sampaio, CE) and 'Gustavo Cruz' (IMO 2021 bronze per OBM's results post: Gustavo Neves da Cruz, Belo Horizonte) folded into the APMO full forms. preferredNames pins D'Emidio (the richness tie-break would otherwise pick imo's title-cased 'D'emidio'). Exact-name cross-dataset merges checked against city/school evidence: Maria Clara Fontes Silva (Aracaju/Coesi: EGOI+IOI+OII+EGMO+APMO), Carolina Moura Valle Costa and Letícia Barbieri Stroeh (Etapa / Etapa Valinhos: EGOI+EGMO), Endy Lumy Okamura Miyashita (Farias Brito: EGOI+EGMO), Bruno Machado Feltran and Enzo Ivamoto Hirota (São Paulo, OBM 2024-25 awardees: physics/informatics + APMO), Arthur Ferreira do Nascimento (OBM 2013 HM, São Paulo: IOI/OII 2014 + APMO 2014, written in full in apmo raw).

OIM/Cono Sur batch 2026-09-09: IMO-DB short forms folded into OBM full forms — 'Gabriel Torkomian' (IMO 2022 team post: Gabriel Cruz Vitale Torkomian, SP), 'Emanuel Carneiro' (OBM Cono Sur 1996 / OIM 1997-98: Emanuel Augusto de Souza Carneiro), 'Edson Bezerra Lopes' (Cono Sur 2005: Edson Augusto Bezerra Lopes, Fortaleza), 'Carlos Gustavo T. de A. Moreira' (OBM 2014/2018 OIM posts name the leader in full: Carlos Gustavo Tamm de Araújo Moreira). Spelling: IMO-DB 'Vajapeyan' vs OBM 'Vajapeyam' (four OBM documents) -> Vajapeyam canonical. Renato Caldas Madeira (OBM OIM 1992 / Cono Sur 1991 'Renato Madeira', Rio) = IMO 1992 'Renato de O. Caldas Madeira' — the IMO form stays canonical (more complete). Assumed identity, flagged in conosur notes: Cono Sur 1994 'Davi Araújo Lima' written as IMO 1995 'Davi Ponciano Araújo Lima'.

Maio/OMCPLP batch 2026-09-09: IMO-DB 'Thiago de Silva Sobral' (2002) = OBM Maio 2000 'Thiago da Silva Sobral' (Fortaleza) — 'da' form canonical. OBM's Maio table uses many short forms (esp. the 2020 virtual year) and spelling variants across years; every expansion is written directly into maio/data/raw (full form from the pool/OBM award lists, city-checked) — see maio/CORROBORATION.md. Assumed identities flagged there: Leonardo Pereira Stédile (Maio 2005/07 = IJSO 2007), Gabriel Militão (2007 = Vinhas Lopes), Yan Victor S. Guimarães (2014 = OII 2019), João Victor Silva dos Santos (Maio 2021 Maceió = 2022 Fortaleza), João Pedro de Almeida da Silva (2022 'João Pedro Almeida', Caruaru = 2024 row, Caruaru = Fortaleza 2025-26).

Rioplatense/RMM batch 2026-09-09: OMA's Rioplatense medal tables (1996-2025) use many short forms; expansions written into rioplatense/data/raw against the pool (city/team-checked). Assumed identities flagged in rioplatense/CORROBORATION.md: Davi Figueiredo (1997 SP = IOI 2001 Davi Tassinari de Figueiredo), Thiago Costa (1998 Fortaleza = Thiago Barros Rodrigues Costa), Ulises Albuquerque (2000 = Ulisses Medeiros de Albuquerque), Matheus Carioca (2013 = Matheus Carioca Sampaio), Adriano Vieira (2000 = Adriano Jorge Braun Vieira Neto). Fuller forms adopted from OMA's 2025 table: Alice Ella Schneider (egmo raw updated), Heloísa Guedes de Azevedo O. Mysczak (alias from the EGMO short form). Israel Franklin Dourado Carrah (OMA 2003) adopted in conosur raw.

IBO batch 2026-09-09: exact-name cross-dataset merges accepted with evidence — Allan dos Santos Costa (IOAA 2013-14 + IBO 2014, OLC lists the same student), Letícia Pereira de Souza (IJSO + IBO 2015, both CE), Pedro Henrique Silva de Oliveira (IJSO 2015-16 + IBO 2018, Fortaleza), Igor Bersanetti Gabilondo, Henrique Pongelupp Oliveira, Gustavo Jun Anraku Oda (IJSO → IBO), Alexandre Andrade de Almeida (IJSO/OIbF/EuPhO + IBO 2024 silver), Nailton Gama de Castro (IChO/OIAQ/IMChO + IBO 2022-23). Felipe Gonçalves de Assis (IBO 2006, PB) = Maio 2001 N1 'Felipe Gonçalves Assis' (Campina Grande) — maio raw updated to the fuller form.

OIAB batch (2026-09-09): exact-name merges accepted with school/city evidence from the OBB international-selection lists and press — Pedro Pinheiro de Negreiros Bessa (OIAB 2007 + IBO 2008), Leo Nunes Benevides (OIAB 2009 + IBO 2010), Pedro Barbosa Oliveira (OIAB 2010 + IBO 2011), Ivan Tadeu Ferreira Antunes Filho (OIAB 2012 + IJSO/IOAA/IPhO, SP), Letícia Pereira de Souza + Gabriel Voltani Guedes (OIAB 2014 + IBO 2015), Gerardo Albino Nogueira Filho (IJSO 2014 + OIAB 2015, Ari de Sá), Bruno Teixeira Gomes (OIAB 2016 + IBO 2017; IBO 2017 short forms expanded from NOIC's team post), Jaziel Barros dos Santos + João Pedro Silva Torres (OIAB 2018 + IBO 2019), Vinícius Kenji Amano Tanaka (Rioplatense/IJSO + OIAB 2021, Etapa Valinhos), Alexandre Andrade de Almeida + Clara Nakata de Carvalho + Iara Vieira Vitarelli (OIAB 2023 + IBO 2024), Arthur Kui (IJSO 2022 + OIAB 2024, Objetivo SP), Marcos Paulo Gonçalves Santos (OIAB 2024 + IBO 2025), David Li Chiun Liu (Maio/Rioplatense/APMO + OIAB 2024 — both Etapa SP), Paulo Vinícius Rodrigues de Azevedo (IJSO 2023/IMChO/IPhO 2025 + OIAB 2025 — rare full name, Fortaleza; assumed identity).

IAO batch (2026-09-10): exact-name merges — Hugo Fonseca Araújo (IAO 2006-07 + Maio 2006, IOAA 2009, RMM 2010), Rafael Parpinel Cavina (IAO 2007 + IJSO 2006, IOAA/IPhO 2008), Cindy Yuchi Tsai (IAO 2007; existing Yuchi/Yushi alias with IJSO 2007 + IOAA 2008), Felipe Gonçalves de Assis (IAO 2006 + IBO 2006, Maio 2001; OLC writes 'Gonçalves Assis'), André Slepetys (IAO 2002 + OII 2004, IOI 2005). Raul Celistrino Teixeira (IAO 2003) kept distinct from Rioplatense 2000's 'Raul Teixeira' for lack of evidence.

OLAA batch (2026-09-10): exact-name merges with the astronomy/physics datasets — Tiago Lobato Gimenes, Tábata Cláudia Amaral de Pontes, Rafael de Lima Bordoni, Larissa Fernandes de Aquino, Luis Fernando Machado Poletti Valle, Carolina Lima Guimarães, Vitor Gomes Pires, Leonardo Henrique Martins Florentino, Bruno Caixeta Piazza, Luã de Souza Santos, Sarah Leitão Melo, Eduardo Henrique Camargo de Toledo, Paulo Henrique dos Santos Silva, Wesley Antônio Machado Andrade de Aguiar, Hugo Fares Menhem, Mariana Naves Tana, Gustavo Mesquita França, Luca Pieroni Pimenta, Lucas Praça Oliveira, Arthur Gomes Gurjão, Felipe Maia Silva, Eyke Cardoso de Souza Torres, João Victor Evers Cordeiro, Rubens Martins Bezerra Farias (IJSO 2012). IYPT batch (2026-09-10): team tournament, medals are team medals. Exact-name merges — Emanuelle Roberta da Silva (IAO 2003 + IYPT 2004-05), Juliana Ogassavara (IJSO 2005), Liara Guinsberg (IJSO/Maio/OIbF/Rioplatense), Leonardo Gushiken Yoshitake (Rioplatense 2009, SP — assumed), Matheus Henrique de Almeida Camacho (IJSO 2012-13), Lucas Prado Vilanova (IOAA 2016), Thomas Ross-White Bergamaschi (IPhO 2018), Bruno Caixeta Piazza (OLAA 2017, IOAA 2018), Gabriel Guerra Trigo (IJSO 2017, EuPhO 2018, IPhO 2019), Vinicius de Alcântara Névoa (EuPhO 2018, OIbF 2019), Eduardo Bardal Slikta (IJSO 2018), Luã de Souza Santos (OLAA 2018, IOAA/EuPhO 2019). Thiago Ross-White Bergamaschi (IYPT 2015) = the IJSO 2014 / IPhO 2016 'Thiago R. Bergamaschi' — full form now preferred. Lucas Henrique Morais (IYPT 2011) = OLAA 2011's contestant (both SP, 2011; IYPT Brasil, the IYPT archive and Wikipedia spell Morais; OLC's 'Moraes' corrected) — assumed identity.

IOL batch (2026-09-10): rosters from ioling.org (official) with fuller forms from obling.org edition pages. Exact-name merges — André Amaral de Sousa (Rioplatense 2008, IOI/OII 2012), Rafael Kazuhiro Miyazaki, Nicolas Seoane Miquelin (Maio 2008), Ivan Tadeu Ferreira Antunes Filho, Bruno Kenzo Ozaki, Brendon Diniz Borck, João Henrique Oliveira Fontes (Maio 2015), Gustavo Baracat Alvares Martins, Leonardo Paillo da Silva (Maio 2018), Wesley Antônio Machado Andrade de Aguiar (EuPhO/OLAA 2021, CMM Manaus), Everton Albuquerque de Oliveira (EuPhO 2022), Lucas Cavalcante Menezes (IOAA 2024, NBPhO 2025), Sophia Li Ci Liu (Maio/PAGMO 2024). Assumed: IOL 2024's 'Paulo Portela' (Farias Brito, Fortaleza) = Paulo Otávio Portela Santana (Maio 2019, IOAA 2022-23, EuPhO 2023) — alias added; 'Pedro Rocha' (2024) kept distinct from Pedro Marinho Rocha (2018) and from the IGO Pedro Henrique Tomás da Rocha.

IESO/iGeo batch (2026-09-10): partial rosters. IESO names come from the official medal lists (igeoscied.org archive) and IF news; iGeo names from OBG's Instagram, school news and press (official iGeo results list gold medallists only). No cross-dataset merges; 'Pablo Fernando de Azurza Nogueira Gomez' is NOIC's 'Pablo Alvarez'.

IEO batch (2026-09-11): exact-name cross-dataset merges accepted as the same person (age-consistent, distinctive names, no school evidence): Pedro Porto de Carvalho Nunes (IGO 2020 -> IEO 2023), Victor Cortez Crocia Barros (IYPT 2018 -> IEO 2019), Rafael Akira Okamura Ferro (IJSO 2017 -> IEO 2019), Nicolas/Nícolas Goulart de Moura (Maio 2019 -> IEO 2021-22; Colégio Objetivo Integrado). Evidence-backed expansions written directly into ieo/data/raw: 2025 short official names -> Banco Central attendance list full names; 2026 'Arthur Spuri' -> Arthur Alencar Spuri (Farias Brito, Fortaleza; IPhO 2026 silver days earlier), merging with the IPhO 2026 entry. Fernando Giron Paranhos de Ávila IEO 2025 = IYPT 2025 (same full name from the Banco Central list).

IEO 2026 'Pedro Câmara' = Pedro Paraguassú Câmara (IYPT 2026 bronze): identified by the maintainer from the team photos (Bain & Company IEO delegation post DbYtUlrD356 vs IYPT Brasil 'Team Brazil IYPT 2026' post Dah8RhYP_iB, 2026-09-11); only overlapping name on the two rosters; IYPT (Zurich, 5–12 Jul) immediately preceded the IEO (Shenzhen, 12–20 Jul). Full name written into ieo/data/raw.

Broad similar-name sweep (2026-09-12, any-shared-token blocking + given-name variants): merged Igor Sousa Almeida (IChO 2004) = Igor de Sousa Almeida (OIAQ 2004; names differ only by 'de' — gate now flags such pairs); Lorenna Rodrigues Silva (OIAQ 2003) = Lorena Rodrigues Silva (IChO 2003; IChO official/host spelling preferred); Daniele Veras de Andrade (IMO 1998) = Danielle Veras de Andrade (Cono Sur 1997; OBM and OLC spelling preferred). OIAQ 2024 'Guillermo Camilo Acevedo' rewritten in oiaq/data/raw as João Guilherme Camilo Azevedo (Roraima chemistry olympiad post: João Guilherme, Colégio Farias Brito, silver) and thereby merged with the IOL 2024/2025 entry. OIAQ 2024 'Alexandre de Almeida' rewritten as Alexandre Andrade de Almeida (Colégio Objetivo Integrado per Objetivo's EuPhO 2024 news; Roraima post: the OIAQ silver 'Alexandre' is from Colégio Objetivo SP).
